title: My Doorbell Camera Caught Me Leaving At 3AM. I Was Already Asleep.
description:
A motion alert from my own front door, at three in the morning, of myself.

#shorts #shortstory #fiction

scenes.text: My doorbell camera sent me a motion alert at three in the morning. Front door, person detected.
I opened it expecting a raccoon. Instead, I watched myself walk out my own front door, in the exact robe I'd gone to bed in.
I checked upstairs first. I was still in bed, asleep, the whole time the camera says I was standing on my porch.
I called the company sure the app had glitched. They confirmed the timestamp. Three-oh-four that morning. Live.
Then, almost as an afterthought, they mentioned this wasn't the first clip like it. Fourteen more, going back eight months, filed under reviewed, no action needed.
scenes.visual_query: laptop screen notification list dark room

scenes.text: Nobody had thought to mention that for eight months, I'd been walking out of my own house every few weeks. And somehow, every single time, I made it back inside before I woke up.
